title: Visual Novel
prompt:
Build a short visual novel with an original story: characters and backgrounds drawn on the canvas, a text box with the speaker's name and 2-3 choice boxes at decisions. Text types out at 1-2 characters per tick from 0; advance() first completes the line, then shows the next. Every path passes at least 2 choices and reaches one of at least 3 endings: always taking the first option, always the last, and alternating last/first (starting with last) must reach three different endings. An ending ends the game. score counts affection points from choices. save(slot) and load(slot) use localStorage key 'kyora-vn-<slot>'. Keyboard: Space/Enter advance, Digit1-Digit3 choose. Touch/mouse: tap advances, tapping a choice box chooses.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, scene, line, speaker, text, visibleChars, choices:[{text}], ending:null|string, history (lines shown)}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.advance(): ignored while choices are shown
- Game.input.choose(i): returns false for an invalid index
- Game.save(slot): returns true
- Game.load(slot): returns false when the slot is empty
- Game.choiceCenter(i): canvas point of choice i

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): typewriter, choices, three endings, save/load, history, determinism, keyboard and tap.
